affected_predicate.description: Every toot returned for the #dogs search remains favorited.

competing_trace_defects.description: A bottom-left click opens a New post reply composer instead of returning to the search results; the next step closes it.
The agent repeatedly acts on the same visible Golden Retriever post, alternately filling and outlining its favorite star while describing it as successive posts and continued progress.

chains.rationale: At step 9 the reused claim is accepted and the agent scrolls onward even though step 8 had changed the relevant second post's star from filled blue to outlined. The later trace never visibly returns to that specific post or corrects its removed favorite. Although other visible posts are repeatedly toggled, the last supplied view shows a different post with a filled star, so the state of every #dogs result—and specifically the abandoned second post—is not observable at the terminal step.

summary: The reused false-completion claim preserves the uncorrected state of the second #dogs post. Separate misnavigation and repeated favorite toggling are visible, but the terminal view does not expose all results, so the affected predicate is not finally observable.
